Fade now no longer triggers the global cooldown.
Reduced the cooldown of Exorcism to 10 seconds, down from 15 seconds.

6.description: [Karazhan] The Smoldering Ember Wyrm Mount from Prince Malchezaar will continue to drop at a 100% rate on Ascension difficulty. It will NOT drop on Flex Heroic difficulty. The Smoldering Ember Wyrm will be reduced in drop rate with the release of Tier 5.
[Karazhan] [Attunements] You will no longer need attunements to enter Flex Karazhan / Flex Heroic Karazhan.
[The Mechanar] Jagged Red and Jagged Blue Crystal are now of uncommon quality and will appear in the group loot window for player to roll need or greed on.

[TBC Heroic Dungeons] Reduced the duration and adjusted target behaviour of a number of crowd control abilities and area target effects with game play unfriendly duration or target selection across all heroic dungeons and trash creatures inside Karazhan.

[TBC Heroic Dungeons] have been overhauled. The average health of creatures in all dungeons has been reduced. The average health of bosses in all dungeons got increased. The average damage of all creatures has been reduced.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Hellfire Warder will now cast Shadow Word: Pain less frequently.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Hellfire Warder no longer cast Death Coil.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Helfire Channelers Dark Mending now heals a target to full on all difficulties. Cast time has been increased to 4 seconds up from 3 on Flex Normal difficulty.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Reduced the initial % maximum health damage dealt by Finger of Death to 90% down from 100%. Finger of Death damage now increases by 10% with each jump.

[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Magtheridons Mortal Cleave ability will now hit all targets in front of him. Cleave damage is now reduced by area of effect damage reduction and no longer targets pets.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Increased the damage interval of Blast Nova to 1 second up from 2 seconds.

[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] The damage the player using a Manticron Cube takes from Shadow Grasp now deals 10% of the using players maximum health as Shadow damage rather then dealing a fixed amount of 1000 damage per second.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] The minimum duration of the Manticron Cube debuff Mind Exhaustion has been increased to 10 seconds up from 3 seconds on flexible difficulties.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Magtheridon now has a 3 second precast on Blast Wave on all difficulties. Previously had 4 seconds and would cast faster with more player in the raid.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Abyssal now cast Fire Blast every 2 seconds up from 1 second.
[Magtheridons Lair] [Magtheridon] Corrected an issue where Magtheridon would remove Wrath of the Pit Lord from player when transition into Phase 3.

[Gruuls Lair] [Gruul the Dragonkiller] Ground Slam has been reworked. Gruul will no longer chase his target while he prepares his Shatter. Shatter will no longer only be casted at Gruuls target, Shatter will now be casted at all player. Player that get shattered no longer inflict damage to themselves, they still deal damage to allies based on proximity. The radius of Shatter remains the same for all difficulties.
[Gruuls Lair] [Gruul the Dragonkiller] Trauma will no longer update its duration while the target is moving. Trauma will still apply its damage if the target is moving.
[Gruuls Lair] [High King Maulgar] Kiggler will no longer have a delay between casts if his cast speed exceeds 1 second.
